summary: 200 OK · 59B markdown · stealthy · this call makes 1 extra direct request to the target before the browser runs: a liveness probe (direct, 3s, no retries, no synthetic headers, no redirect hop). Your service's own log will show that one next to the browser's navigation - it is dhole dialing, not the page. · the target is loopback/private, so the browser tier navigated without dhole's invented google referer. What that browser sends of its own (UA, `sec-ch-ua*`, `sec-fetch-*`) arrived as it always does, plus every header you named · 1 action(s) waiting for user approval (click 'button[type=submit]')
next_action: a submit action is PAUSED for user approval (pending_approval in metadata.actions) - describe the submission to the user and ask for confirmation; on a yes, re-run the same actions with confirm: true on the click/submit action itself (e.g. {"click": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}} or {"submit": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}}), not at the top level. Nothing irreversible was done.

actions.lifetime: the files ride THIS page instance - submit within the same call (a later call starts a fresh page)

actions.error: pending_approval: submitting is an irreversible step - ask the user to confirm this submission, then re-run the same actions with confirm: true on the click/submit action itself (e.g. {"click": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}} or {"submit": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}}), not at the top level on this click. Nothing was submitted.
the selector matched no element (or none became actionable) before the timeout: Locator.inner_text: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.
